name: Corsair iCUE Link and PSU Support
author: Robin Kipp and Sensor Readout contributors
description: Opt-in monitoring and fan control for supported Corsair iCUE LINK Hub cooling devices and Corsair HXi/RMi digital power supplies. Do not run together with Corsair iCUE. Monitoring can run alongside HWiNFO or Fan Control through the shared Corsair device guard, but only one program should drive the fans.
